t: Tried a lot to skip my sips for a month and it shows it can be done 2 days before sip date, but even before 2 days it doesn't work. I recently got operated on my knee and I'm facing financial issues
Allow us to pause SIPs indefinitely. Currently you can skip 1 installment or cancel completely but I just want to pause for a few months.
auto payment fails in mutual fund sip and there is no retry done by the app. If i don't open the app and do payment of sip manually the payment does not happen and remains pending.

App interface is bad after this latest update. in mutual fund Dashboard section daily and overall profit were shown in Green Colour and Loss were Shown in Red Colour Font. But after update Both Profit and Loss are showing in White colour font which is very confusing

In the Mutual Fund section in the dashboard tab, against all the MFs there should be tagging/purpose/goal. Most of the people invest in SIP for specific purpose like Trip, Child Marriage, Child Education

There should be a review section for mutual funds with categories like 'In-form', 'On-track', and 'Out-of-form'; this would make it easier to understand where to invest, where to stop an SIP, and where to exit.

NEVER USE GROWW! Withdrawal money never credited. I invested in an emergency liquid mutual fund, but when I placed my first withdrawal order, Groww executed it without crediting the money. Support did not help.
Prime Mutual fund in groww app is a SCAM. They don't tell clearly but manipulate you into buying regular (costly) mutual funds.

Started using Groww for mutual funds and stocks just 2 days ago, and already disappointed. There are hidden charges on small services that aren't clearly disclosed upfront, and customer support has been slow.
Customer support is very pathetic even in 2026. The team lacks a lot of knowledge and they don't know even the basics of MF and Stocks.
great app for sip
As a 22 years old beginner investor, i found groww extremely simple and user friendly. i started my first sip last month without any hassle.

Some SIPs for the month of Aug have been failed, rest one of the best app.
Even Mutual Funds, price shows 11% increase and when you Redeem, it shows 11% loss. BIG CHEAT.
Please include 1 Week and 1 Month return views in the Mutual Fund Dashboard section, in addition to the 1 Day return, to facilitate investment decisions during market declines.
The app makes investing simple, but redeeming your money is a huge problem. I requested a withdrawal 3 weeks ago and the funds were never credited to my bank account.
Currently, you cannot directly edit an existing SIP to change the amount. To increase your SIP amount from 300 to 600, you will need to cancel your current SIP and then create a new one.
Too slow in processing SIP orders. Deadline for completing the MF order gets violated and on reaching support desk they ask to wait for another 3 to 4 working days.
